subject: New Connection Request from $requester_name - Alumni Network
body:
Dear $recipient_name,

You have received a new connection request from a fellow alumnus!

From: $requester_name
Graduation Year: $requester_grad_year
Current Position: $requester_job_title at $requester_employer

$personal_message_section

To view and respond to this request, please log in to the Alumni Portal.

Building connections with fellow alumni is a great way to expand your professional network and stay engaged with the university community.

Best regards,
The Alumni Relations Team
University Alumni Network
